title: Case Analysis Artifact Schema
description: Defines the structure for artifacts logged during a Kotler case study analysis.

session_id.description: A unique identifier for the analysis session.

timestamp.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was performed.

user_request.description: The initial, high-level request from the user.

workflow_log.description: A log of the key steps and intermediate results from the agent's workflow.

final_summary.description: The final, human-readable summary of the analysis presented to the user.
